TreeSource.description:
Where the tree comes from:
- `shadowTree`: the host's `getA11yTree` (committed ShadowTree, full   hierarchy, typed values).
- `mounted`: Fantom's `getRenderedOutput` (mounted views after view   flattening, debug-string props).

ref.description: Id within one tree: `n0`, `n1`, ... in pre-order (changes when the tree changes).

key.description: Stable key: `testID` when set, else `<parent key>/<type>:<n>` (n = index among siblings of the same type); the root is its type.

type.description: Host component name: `View`, `Paragraph`, `Image`, `Text` (text fragment, mounted source only), ...

sel.description: Selector for this node. `#testID` when a testID is set, otherwise a path of types with 1-based sibling indices, e.g. `RootView>View>Paragraph:2`.

role.description: Accessibility role: `role` prop, else `accessibilityRole`, else the component default; `null` if none.

name.description: Accessible name: label, else aria-label, else own text, else descendant text if accessible.

box.description: On-screen frame in dp: sum of parent frames, minus the `contentOffset` of ancestor ScrollViews (`shadowTree` source).

style.description: Other props reported by the host: visual style, flattened Yoga style, font props (Paragraph), component props (Image sources, TextInput placeholder, ...). Strings for the `mounted` source.

text.description: Text content (Paragraph, Text fragment, TextInput value), else `null`.

virtual.description: `true` when the host node has no frame of its own (nested `<Text>` span kept for its a11y props, or another virtual node). `box` is then the parent's box. Only for the `shadowTree` source.

visualBox.description: Where the node is drawn, when it differs from `box`: the bounding box of the (mounted) frame after the transforms of the node and its ancestors (`shadowTree` source). Absent when there is no transform or mounted frame override on the path.

effectiveOpacity.description: Product of the node's and its ancestors' opacity (mounted opacity when the host reports one). Present only when below 1.

expo.description: Expo module views (`@expo/ui`, type `ExpoUI.<View>`): the props the view received (`modifiers` verbatim; modifier callbacks are `"eventListener": null`).

layout.description: Expo module views: `emulated` when a SwiftUI/Compose layout engine (or the Host's content sizing) produced the frame, `placeholder` when no engine handled the subtree (the frame is not the drawn one). Hosts before the label change mark only the Host `emulated`.

emulatedBy.description: On an Expo Host: the engine that laid out its subtree.

debugProps.description: Raw debug props from the host; only with `--debug-props` and the `shadowTree` source.

accessible.description: `accessible` prop (or `true` for elements that are accessible by default).

raw.description: Raw accessibility-related props as reported by the host. Strings for the `mounted` source; typed values for the `shadowTree` source.

x.description: Absolute position in the viewport, in dp.

ExpoLayoutEngine.description: Layout engine of an Expo Host (`emulatedBy`).

Diagnostic.description: Observed limitations, not a certificate of native equivalence when empty.
